audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of 60 festival event and choice strings. Canonical Egg Festival, Flower Dance, Luau, Festival of Ice, Mayor Lewis, Slingshot, Star Token and Yoba terminology, response identifiers, placeholders, dialogue commands, spaces and character voice were checked against the English source.

records.english: Um, excuse me.#$b#I have a gift for you. I found it last summer when I was playing at the beach. I hope you like it.$h
records.translation: Ем, перепрошую.#$b#У мене є для тебе подарунок. Я знайшов його минулого літа, коли грався на пляжі. Сподіваюся, він тобі сподобається.$h

records.english: I'm glad you moved here, farmer @!$h

records.english: It's not much, but I hope you like it.$h
